open_points.subject: M02 Slot / author contract action
open_points.text: "slot_id`: a stable name the creating agent chooses; unique in the kernel, and a name already taken is refused;"
open_points.question: Is reusing an existing slot name allowed when issuing a new contract version for that slot, or does any already-taken name have to be refused?
options: Allow existing slot_id for new contract versions; refuse only when trying to create a new slot with a taken name
Refuse any authoring request that names an existing slot_id
open_points.default_guess: Allow existing slot_id for new contract versions; treat the refusal as applying only to first-slot creation.

open_points.subject: M09 Activation identity and multiplicity
open_points.text: "Every content-derived identity and digest in this kernel is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the model's meaning facts — never of who created it or when." + M09 has no `activation_id` and says "rollback is another activation."
open_points.question: When the same implementation is activated again for the same contract version, is that a new Activation record or the same one reused?
options: Write a new Activation record each time activation happens, even if target is identical
Keep only one Activation per (contract_version_id, implementation_id) and treat re-activation as no new record
open_points.default_guess: Write a new Activation record each time; use append order to determine current activation.

open_points.subject: M18 FlowActivation identity and multiplicity
open_points.text: "Every content-derived identity and digest ... never of who created it or when." + M18 has no `flow_activation_id` and says "switching back is another activation."
open_points.question: If a flow version is activated, later replaced, then activated again, must that second activation be a distinct persisted record?
options: Yes, each activation event is a new FlowActivation record
No, activation is unique per flow_version_id and repeated activation reuses prior record
open_points.default_guess: Yes, persist a new FlowActivation record per activation event.

open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt resend authority for `draft-write`
open_points.text: "authority`: the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send the flow activation of the run's version" and "Sending again after `not_applied` is a new attempt under a fresh approval, never under a standing approval (K-08)."
open_points.question: After a `draft-write` attempt is concluded `not_applied`, does resend require a fresh owner approval, or can it proceed under flow activation authority again?
options: Fresh owner approval required for any resend after `not_applied`, including `draft-write`
`draft-write` resends continue under flow activation authority; fresh approval rule applies only to approval-gated classes
open_points.default_guess: `draft-write` resends continue under flow activation authority; fresh-approval resend applies to approval-gated effect classes only.
